hero.headline: Find your next
hero.body: Sign in with your phone number to start matching, chatting, and meeting people who are actually worth your time.

how.title: From hello to first date in three steps

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Add your best photos, answer a few prompts, and pick the interests that say the most about you.

steps.title: Swipe with intent
steps.body: Like who catches your eye, pass on who doesn't, and send a rose when someone really stands out.

steps.title: Match and talk
steps.body: When it's mutual, the chat opens. Send messages, photos, and voice notes right away.

home.featuresTitle: Built for connections that go somewhere

features.title: Smart matches
features.body: We surface people who actually fit what you’re looking for, not just who’s nearby.

features.title: Real conversations
features.body: Chat, share photos, and send voice notes the moment you match — no waiting around.

features.title: Verified profiles
features.body: Phone-verified sign-in and moderation keep the people you meet real.

features.title: Your privacy first
features.body: Block and report anyone, anytime. You’re always in control of who can reach you.

features.title: Travel mode
features.body: Heading somewhere new? Set your location ahead of time and start matching before you land.

features.title: Roses
features.body: Skip the queue. A rose puts you at the top of someone’s likes and shows you mean it.

safety.title: You’re in control, always
safety.body: Every account is phone-verified, every report is reviewed, and you decide who can reach you.
